Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

geoGraph v2.1.0

  • dijkstraBetween(x, from, to) on a gGraph now returns every path from each node of from to each node of to. With to missing or identical to from, all pairs of from are computed, as before. polygonBetween() benefits from this.

  • gPath objects record their type; gPath2dist() uses it and returns a from x to matrix for the output of dijkstraBetween() with distinct from and to (and so for polygonBetween()). dijkstraBetween() on a gData with two locations now returns a dist, as for more locations.

  • dijkstraBuffer() includes the origin node and works on graphs that are not fully connected.

  • isInArea() errors on an invalid reg (it returned NA), and accepts reg = c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax).

  • findLand(), assignByPolygon() and buffer() replace existing node attributes of the same name instead of adding duplicated columns; findLand() always returns a factor with levels land and sea.

  • assignByRaster() removes NAs itself (when na.rm = TRUE) before applying fun, so any summary function works, including length and functions without an na.rm argument. na.rm is no longer passed to fun.

  • polygonBetween() only accepts gGraph objects (for gData use dijkstraBetween() on the linked gGraph instead).

  • makeHexGrid() is much faster on large grids , neighbors are found with a nearest-neighbor search instead of spdep.

  • setDistCosts() is about 8x faster; its documentation now states that costs are in miles.

  • dijkstraBuffer() is much faster: it no longer builds every path.

  • new("gData", nodes.id = ...) no longer ignores nodes.id; new("gGraph", meta = ...) no longer ignores meta; new("gGraph") accepts coordinates without column names.

  • gGraph objects without node attributes (e.g. from makeSquareGrid() or makeHexGrid(), or saved with older versions) can be subset, and work with getNodesAttr(), setNodesAttr(), buffer(), dijkstraBuffer(), assignByRaster() and geom_ggraph().

  • setCosts(), getNodeCosts() and getColors() no longer chain rules when a cost or color equals another attribute value.

  • assignByPolygon() and findLand() handle layers in a projected CRS, and assignByPolygon() works on gData objects with several locations on the same node.

  • closestNode() accepts a single location as c(lon, lat).

  • polygonBetween() detects polygon outlines correctly on subset graphs.

  • areConnected() no longer reports an isolated node as connected in graphs without edges.

  • combineCosts() compares the edges of the two graphs reliably.

  • dropDeadEdges() also drops edges when all costs are equal.

  • dijkstraFrom() on a gData gives an informative error when start is not connected to the locations.

  • Plotting: plotEdges() works with a single visible edge; points() keeps per-node colors on the right nodes when zoomed in; plot(x, shape = NULL) draws the nodes of the new area; geo.segments() keeps per-segment colors with their segments.

  • [ and geom_gdata() work on gData objects whose data is a vector.

  • Validity checks give informative messages.

geoGraph v2.0.1

  • Added ggplot2 support for gGraph, gData, and gPath objects via autoplot() methods and geom_ggraph(), geom_gdata(), and geom_gpath() layers.

  • closestNode now uses a faster KNN implementation for nearest neighbor searches by default. The legacy zone-expansion method is still available via method = “inArea”.

  • Functions that temporarily toggle sf settings now restore the prior state on exit.

  • Updated gPath2dist to now automatically return a vector or dist object based on the input type

  • Updated makeHexGrid to handle date line crossing gGraph objects

  • Updated isInArea to print a reproducible bounding box message

  • Added assignByRaster to assign raster cell values to graph nodes with customizable aggregation.

  • Added dijkstraBuffer to identify nodes within a specified shortest-path distance from an origin.

  • Added makeHexGrid for explicit hexagonal grid construction.

  • Deprecated extractFromLayer in favor of assignByPolygon and makeGrid in favor of makeSquareGrid.

  • Added documentation for the gPath class and basic subsetting methods for gGraph and gData objects

  • Added setGraph and setColors as well as updated functionality in getColors, getCosts, and setCosts

  • Removed getHistory method for gGraph objects and upgraded roxygen2 documentation from version 7.3.3 to 8.0.0

  • Added comprehensive test coverage for cost functions and updated documentation

  • Updated plot.gPath() and documentation for all dijkstra methods

  • Updated connectivityPlot() ensuring the color assignment matches the connected set

  • Fix incorrect handling of duplicate nodes in dijkstraBetween(), ensuring zero-distance paths are properly represented.

  • remove all use of deprecated packages (sp and maptools), and move to sf objects

geoGraph v1.1

  • Update documentation to roxygen.
  • Make vignette fully live.

geoGraph v1.0

  • First public release with full functionality.
